definition: Conformist means a person who behaves the same way as everyone around them.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word conformist. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know conformist should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: A conformist to the last, Deng studied the other diners before ordering exactly what the next table had.

A follower surrenders less than a conformist — a follower falls in behind one leader or fashion and may still keep a private opinion or two, while the conformist's own tastes surrender along with everything else.
Sheep goes further than conformist — the conformist still chooses to match the crowd, while calling people sheep says the choosing has stopped altogether.

A copycat imitates one particular person — the same jokes, the same handwriting, traceable to a single model. A conformist has no single model: he matches the whole crowd around him, and the group's sameness, not any one person's example, is what his choices copy.

A yes-man agrees with whoever holds power — the boss floats a weak idea and hears only yes. A conformist needs no boss: the pressure comes sideways, from everybody at once, and it is the crowd's habits, not anyone's orders, that a conformist's choices dissolve into.
